## Notes

A run switch between turns, in the result line's quiet rule: the refresh icon and the switch, with the handover's progress under it. Copy comes from packages/shared/run-switch.ts (switchText, handoverNote): - same harness: "Switched to effort high", "Switched to Sonnet 5.5, default effort" (no note) - another harness: "Handing over from Claude Code (Opus 5.5) to Codex (GPT-6-Luna)", note "Codex reads the thread so far with your next message." until it runs, then "Handover complete. Codex read 11 entries into a new session." - replaced before it ran: note "Replaced by a later switch."; back before anything ran: "Switched back to ..., which continues its own session" Never a status pop: a switch is Ben's choice, not an agent's state.
